list.name: account
list.label: Customer
list.query: SELECT account, display_name FROM n360.account ORDER BY display_name
list.definition: SELECT account, display_name FROM n360.account ORDER BY display_name

panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
The customer's features adopted (of the six), the conversations that ran at least one playbook and the share handed off from within one, and the next feature to move to (V8 / V9, Cortex, Recipes, then the rest). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_customer_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, concat(any(a.display_name), ': ', toString(any(c.features_adopted)), ' of 6 features · ',
                   'playbooks ran in ', if(any(c.conversations) IS NULL, NULL, if(any(c.conversations) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(any(c.conversations), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(any(c.conversations), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(any(c.conversations) % 1000), 3, '0')), if(any(c.conversations) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(any(c.conversations), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(any(c.conversations) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(any(c.conversations))))), ' conversations in 31 days, ',
                   toString(round(any(c.handoff_pct))), '% handed off · ',
                   if(any(c.next_feature) = '', 'every feature adopted', concat('next step: ', any(c.next_feature))))) AS sentence
        FROM n360.v_customer_adoption AS c INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: Playbook executions, 31 days
panels.description:
Playbook executions on V8 VAs in the 31 days to the data-through day. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.va_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, sum(executions)) AS `across every V8 playbook` FROM n360.va_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Conversations with a playbook
panels.description:
Conversations that ran at least one playbook, 31 days. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.va_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, sum(conversations)) AS `ran at least one` FROM n360.va_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Handed off from a playbook
panels.description:
Handoffs to an agent from within a playbook, as a share of the conversations that ran one. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.va_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(sum(conversations) = 0, NULL, round(100 * sum(handoffs) / sum(conversations), 1)) AS `of those conversations`
        FROM n360.va_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Features adopted
panels.description:
Of the six features, how many this customer has adopted on at least one VA (V8 / V9: on every VA). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_customer_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, any(features_adopted)) AS `of 6` FROM n360.v_customer_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Six features, VA by VA
panels.description:
Each VA against the six features: green adopted, amber partly, light grey not yet, grey not reported. Hover a heading for what adopted means; the evidence behind each cell is in the table below. Click a VA for its playbooks and configuration. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_va_feature_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.va AS VA, any(f.region) AS Region, countIf(f.state = 'adopted') AS `Adopted, of 6`, anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'Cortex') AS `Cortex`,
               anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'Test / playbook validation') AS `Testing`,
               anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'Calibration') AS `Calibration`,
               anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'V8 / V9') AS `V8 / V9`,
               anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'Action-oriented recipes') AS `Recipes`,
               anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'Explorer') AS `Explorer`,
               toString(f.bot_id) AS bot, any(f.account) AS acct
        FROM n360.v_va_feature_adoption AS f WHERE f.account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY f.va, f.bot_id ORDER BY `Adopted, of 6` DESC, VA

properties.value: Used to create or edit a production playbook in the last 30 days. Cortex is read for US VAs only and has no user id: whether Netomi or the customer ran a session is not known yet.
Run on every playbook version before promotion (Behavior Validation on, with test runs). Runs with validation off = partly.
At least monthly on Tier 1 and Tier 2 use cases: a run in the last 31 days (n360.settings adoption_calibration_days). An older run = partly (lapsed).
Production VA running on V8 or V9; target 100%. A customer is adopted only when every VA is.
At least one production recipe performs a write against a customer system. Recipes built but none writing in production = partly.
At least one question by a customer user in the last 30 days, in Production or Staging; Netomi staff not counted.

panels.title: The evidence behind each feature
panels.description:
For each feature: where the customer stands, every VA's reading, and the definition it is judged by. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_customer_feature_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT feature AS Feature, concat(state, '|', value) AS `This customer`, detail AS `VA by VA`, means AS `What adopted means`
        FROM n360.v_customer_feature_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY ord

properties.value: Adopted on any VA; V8 / V9 only when every VA is.

panels.title: Executions by playbook
panels.description:
The 20 busiest playbooks over 31 days. Hover a bar for the count. Long tails are normal; one playbook carrying most of a VA is a single point of failure. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(playbook, '  ·  ', va) AS Playbook, executions AS Executions
        FROM n360.v_playbook WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND executions > 0 ORDER BY executions DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Length against traffic
panels.description:
Every production playbook as a point: instruction length across, executions up. Top right (long and busy) is where a change is riskiest and testing matters most; bottom right (long and quiet) is effort that is not used. Hover a point for the playbook. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT instruction_chars AS `Instructions (characters)`, executions AS `Executions, 31 days`, playbook AS Playbook,
               va AS VA
        FROM n360.v_playbook WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND executions IS NOT NULL ORDER BY instruction_chars

panels.title: Every playbook
panels.description:
Every production playbook (the v1.1 complexity table): instruction, tool and trigger size, length band, executions and their share of the VA's, whether it ran, and who built it. Click a VA for its page. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT playbook AS Playbook, va AS VA, length_band AS Length, instruction_chars AS `Instructions (characters)`, tools AS Tools,
               trigger_chars AS `Trigger (characters)`, if(short, 'yes', 'no') AS `Short (<200)`,
               executions AS `Executions, 31 days`, share_of_va_pct AS `Share of the VA`,
               multiIf(idle IS NULL, NULL, idle, 'Idle', 'Ran') AS `In use`, ifNull(built_by, '') AS `Built by`,
               toString(bot_id) AS bot, account
        FROM n360.v_playbook WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY VA, rank_on_va

panels.title: Length bands, VA by VA
panels.description:
Production playbooks per VA in each length band (instruction characters). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT va AS VA, count() AS Playbooks, countIf(length_band = '<200 (short)') AS `<200 (short)`,
               countIf(length_band = '200-999') AS `200-999`,
               countIf(length_band = '1000-2999') AS `1000-2999`,
               countIf(length_band = '3000-5999') AS `3000-5999`,
               countIf(length_band = '6000-9999') AS `6000-9999`,
               countIf(length_band = '10000+') AS `10000+`, toString(bot_id) AS bot, any(account) AS acct
        FROM n360.v_playbook WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY va, bot_id ORDER BY VA

panels.title: Who built them
panels.description:
Production playbooks by who created them (creator email domain; n360.settings adoption_staff_domain). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(built_by = 'Customer') AS `The customer`, countIf(built_by = 'Netomi') AS Netomi,
               countIf(built_by IS NULL) AS `Not reported`
        FROM n360.v_playbook WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Live but idle
panels.description:
Production V8 playbooks with no execution in their window. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql: SELECT playbook AS Playbook, va AS VA FROM n360.v_playbook WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND idle ORDER BY VA, Playbook

panels.title: Cortex sessions per day
panels.description:
Cortex sessions per day on the customer's US VAs (who ran them is not known yet). Read since 5 Oct 2026; a day read with none is 0.

**Source:** n360.cortex_day  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, sum(authoring_sessions) AS Sessions FROM n360.cortex_day
        WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Engine, week by week
panels.description:
Each VA's engine version at each weekly configuration read: green V8 or later, amber older. Hover for the version.

**Source:** n360.va_config_snapshot  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range, weekly reads

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(c.snapshot_date) AS time, concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, c.engine_version AS Engine
        FROM n360.va_config_snapshot AS c INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = c.bot_id
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(c.snapshot_date) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Configuration, VA by VA
panels.description:
Per VA, the v1.1 configuration table: engine and playbooks, legacy intents left, idle playbooks, calibration, Behavior Validation and test runs, recipes live and their write actions, MCP servers (live, set up but not live, names) and supervisory rules (live, default). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.va_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT va AS VA, engine_version AS Engine, playbooks_live AS `Playbooks live`, legacy_intents AS `Legacy intents`,
               idle_playbooks AS Idle,
               concat(toString(ifNull(calibration_runs, 0)), if(calibration_runs = 1, ' run, ', ' runs, '),
                      toString(ifNull(calibration_completed, 0)), ' completed') AS Calibration,
               concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(calibration_last)), ' ', formatDateTime(calibration_last, '%b %Y')) AS `Last calibrated`, ifNull(behavior_validation, 'not set') AS `Behavior Validation`,
               test_runs AS `Test runs`, concat(toString(ifNull(recipes_production, 0)), ' of ', toString(ifNull(recipes, 0)), ' live') AS Recipes,
               recipe_actions AS `Write actions`,
               concat(toString(ifNull(mcp_live, 0)), ' live', if(ifNull(mcp_not_live, 0) > 0, concat(', ', toString(mcp_not_live), ' set up, not live'), '')) AS `MCP servers`,
               mcp_names AS `MCP names`,
               concat(toString(ifNull(supervisory_live, 0)), ' live, ', toString(ifNull(supervisory_default, 0)), ' default') AS `Supervisory rules`,
               supervisory_names AS `Rule names`, toString(bot_id) AS bot, account
        FROM n360.va_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY VA

panels.title: Cortex sessions per week: Netomi and the customer
panels.description:
Cortex sessions per week by Netomi users and by the customer's own users, side by side. The customer's line rising while Netomi's falls is the hand-over working. Hover for the week. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range, weeks from Monday

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toMonday(day)) AS time, sumIf(sessions, who = 'Netomi') AS Netomi,
               sumIf(sessions, who = 'Customer') AS `The customer`
        FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Executions: Netomi-built and customer-built playbooks
panels.description:
Playbook executions in 31 days, split by who created the playbook (creator domain): Netomi (blue-grey) or the customer (green), as a share. Hover for the counts. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pb.va AS VA, sumIf(pb.executions, pb.built_by = 'Netomi') AS `Built by Netomi`,
               sumIf(pb.executions, pb.built_by = 'Customer') AS `Built by the customer`,
               sumIf(pb.executions, pb.built_by IS NULL) AS `Builder not reported`
        FROM n360.v_playbook AS pb INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = pb.account
        WHERE pb.account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY VA ORDER BY sum(pb.executions) DESC
